name: Human Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that human sin originated with the first disobedience in the Garden of Eden, when the serpent deceived Eve, leading to the fall of mankind (Genesis 3:1). This original act introduced sin and death into the world, affecting all humanity, as Paul explains that through one man sin entered the world and death spread to all because all have sinned (Romans 5:12; Romans 3:23). The Bible emphatically states that no one is righteous on their own (Romans 3:10), and the consequence of sin is death. Yet, God offers the gift of eternal life through Jesus Christ, providing the only hope for redemption (Romans 6:23).
